title: The Bright Static Again
author: Sable Almeida
blurb: Astrid Dravenmoor, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
